title: Distiller component source
description: Where a Wine build or graphics layer that recipes name by tag comes from, how Distiller verifies and installs it, and what it provides. One file per tag: components/<kind>/<tag>.yaml. A source is a program that runs on players' Macs, so a maintainer reviews every change.

tag.description: What recipes name: stack.runner.family for Wine builds (unless provides.family says otherwise).

license.description: SPDX expression. Wine and builds of it are LGPL-2.1-or-later.

github_release.description: Downloaded from the publisher's GitHub releases, and only when GitHub publishes a SHA-256 checksum for the file, which the download must match.

asset.description: Regular expression for the file to download; its first group (in parentheses) is the version. The newest matching file is installed and followed for updates.

family.description: Wine builds: the family recipes name, and what bottles made with it can move to.

libraries_from.description: Another Wine source whose installed build supplies shared libraries this one leaves out (GStreamer, FFmpeg, GLib…). Distiller adds the ones it's missing, then checks every library it loads is there.

contains_d3dmetal.description: The download includes Apple's D3DMetal. Its publisher answers for it under Apple's terms; Distiller labels it and tells players before downloading.
